home.title: Cupping & Hijama Therapy
home.desc: Create your hijama protocols and manage areas, techniques, application flow, safety notes, information and sources in a single workspace.

protocols.title: Hijama Protocols
protocols.desc: Manage areas, techniques, application flow, safety, information and sources in one place, organised by complaint or working purpose.

calendar.title: Hijama Calendar
calendar.desc: Create your own annual hijama working calendar; view Gregorian and Hijri dates together and choose your application days yourself.

points.title: Hijama Points
points.desc: View hijama areas and their saved descriptions.

techniques.title: Cupping Techniques
techniques.desc: Manage dry, wet and other application techniques.

safety.title: Safety & Contraindications
safety.desc: Create and edit your own safety / caution items and link them to protocols.

home.note: Note: This module organises traditional-use / sourced relationship information; no topic automatically implies that it "treats" anything.
